entries.reason: Pure facade: every item was a glob re-export of aphrody-m3-tokens plus 5 small contracts (accessibility, icons, platform, API_VERSION, export_css/export_brand_css). A crate boundary for 214 lines of re-exports is cost without isolation. A module (not a root re-export) was chosen because the root already owns `color`, `sheets` and `export_css` (different signature: export_css(&ColorRoles) vs the facade's export_css()), so root re-exports would clash. Public path mapping: aphrody_m3::X -> aphrody_m3_tokens::facade::X for X in color, sheets, layout, typography, motion, theme, accessibility, icons, platform, API_VERSION, export_css, export_brand_css. Dropped as redundant: `aphrody_m3::tokens` (alias of the token crate itself, zero users; callers use aphrody_m3_tokens directly). Facade is gated on `std` (it already needed std: String, blend/hct/dynamic/sheets are std-only), so the no_std/no_alloc build of aphrody-m3-tokens is unchanged. Intra-crate paths: aphrody_m3_tokens::X became crate::X; facade-internal `crate::platform`/`crate::layout` became `super::platform`/`super::layout`. The 3 facade unit tests moved with the code (module `facade::tests`) and the README example became a doc-test of the module.
